g.text: Two channels, both values · custody lives in Document · the runtime never asks
Canvas runtime — driven · owns the frame path · zero I/O
Driven: whole state reconstructible from setPages + install.
A page without content is a placeholder — never an editable blank.
Variable page sizes: prefix-sum layout, window from the visible rect.
orange → value reports going up — the ink travels inside them
violet → durable writes — plan · write · fsync barrier · index last
teal → checkout — one Document per package, enforced in the type
dashed grey → derived data, disposable by rule
